prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Feeding and Caring for Your Companion", "Try giving your pet its first snack and interaction to see how it responds on your desktop.", "Feed Pet Snack"]
1: ["Secure Your Pet Save Data", "Signing in ensures your desktop companion, items, and settings are backed up to cloud storage automatically.", "Use your primary email to avoid duplicate empty accounts.", "Continue to Sign In"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Sprite & Audio Assets", "Optimizing companion movement animations and sound effects for your desktop environment.", "Your desktop companion will appear as soon as initialization completes."]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Click your system tray icon to summon, hide, mute, or talk to your desktop companion at any time.", "Right-click tray icon to open quick menu\nPress shortcut to hide or show pet instantly\nDrag pet anywhere on desktop"]
4: ["For best pet generation, upload centered photos with good lighting and clear background contrast."]
5: ["Sign In to Protect & Save Your Companion", "Link your account now to ensure your companion, accessories, and memory progress are safely stored in the cloud."]
6: ["Customize Ambient Sound & Desktop Lighting", "Select your preferred ambient sound effects and light aura while your companion is being built.", "Choose sound theme: Soft Chime, Nature Waves, Silent"]
7: ["You're All Set! Quick Desktop Commands", "Use Alt+P to summon or hide your pet. Right-click the pet for quick actions and settings anytime.", "Launch Desktop Pet"]
8: ["Registering companion license code and generating official adoption seal..."]
9: ["Active companion path offers regular chat prompts; Quiet companion path stays subtly docked until clicked."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information (primary email address).
Asks for personal photos of the user.
